blocks.content: Create a Grafana-managed recording rule on your Grafana Cloud stack to see how the parts of the form produce a recorded metric. You query the recorded metric in Explore to see the data the rule wrote, then delete the rule.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Explain what the rule name and the metric name each identify
- Identify the data source a rule queries and the target data source it writes to
- Explain what an evaluation group and an evaluation interval control
- Interpret the data points of a recorded metric in Explore

## Before you begin

Before you start, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud stack where you have the Admin role
- The `grafanacloud-usage` data source, which the path queries

The path creates a rule and a folder on your stack, and deletes both at the end.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

To go further, refer to [Create Grafana-managed recording rules](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/alerting-rules/create-recording-rules/create-grafana-managed-recording-rules/) and the [Create recording rules](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/alerting-rules/create-recording-rules/) overview.
